heading: Cyber protection support for personnel of the Department of State in positions highly vulnerable to cyber attack

children.heading: At-risk personnel
children.text: The term “at-risk personnel” means personnel of the Department—
whom the Secretary determines to be highly vulnerable to cyber attacks and hostile information collection activities because of their positions in the Department; and
whose personal technology devices or personal accounts are highly vulnerable to cyber attacks and hostile information collection activities.

children.heading: Personal accounts
children.text: The term “personal accounts” means accounts for online and telecommunications services, including telephone, residential internet access, email, text and multimedia messaging, cloud computing, social media, health care, and financial services, used by Department personnel outside of the scope of their employment with the Department.

children.heading: Personal technology devices
children.text: The term “personal technology devices” means technology devices used by personnel of the Department outside of the scope of their employment with the Department, including networks to which such devices connect.

tree.heading: Requirement to provide cyber protection support
tree.text: The Secretary, in consultation with the Secretary of Homeland Security and the Director of National Intelligence, as appropriate—

children.text: shall offer cyber protection support for the personal technology devices and personal accounts of at-risk personnel; and
may provide the support described in paragraph (1) to any Department personnel who request such support.

tree.heading: Nature of cyber protection support
tree.text: Subject to the availability of resources, the cyber protection support provided to personnel pursuant to subsection (b) may include training, advice, assistance, and other services relating to protection against cyber attacks and hostile information collection activities.

tree.heading: Privacy protections for personal devices
tree.text: The Department is prohibited pursuant to this section from accessing or retrieving any information from any personal technology device or personal account of Department employees unless—

children.text: access or information retrieval is necessary for carrying out the cyber protection support specified in this section; and
the Department has received explicit consent from the employee to access a personal technology device or personal account prior to each time such device or account is accessed.

tree.heading: Rule of construction
tree.text: Nothing in this section may be construed—

children.text: to encourage Department personnel to use personal technology devices for official business; or
to authorize cyber protection support for senior Department personnel using personal devices, networks, and personal accounts in an official capacity.

children.heading: In general
children.text: Not later than 180 days after December 22, 2023, the Secretary shall submit to the appropriate committees of Congress a report regarding the provision of cyber protection support pursuant to subsection (b), which shall include—
a description of the methodology used to make the determination under subsection (a)(1); and
guidance for the use of cyber protection support and tracking of support requests for personnel receiving cyber protection support pursuant to subsection (b).

children.heading: Appropriate committees of Congress defined
children.text: In this subsection, the term “appropriate committees of Congress” means—
the Select Committee on Intelligence and the Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs of the Senate; and
the Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence and the Committee on Oversight and Accountability of the House of Representatives.

notes.text: For definitions of “Department”, “Secretary”, and “appropriate congressional committees” as used in this section, see section 6002 of Pub. L. 118–31, set out as a note under section 2651 of this title.
